scope: server bot/workbench status enrichment durable-job disk fallback; no RPC, UI, deployment, or credential access

implementation.change: Read each durable job file with fs::read and deserialize with serde_json::from_slice::<macbot_durable::Job>.
implementation.reason: The previous File plus from_reader path performed unbuffered byte reads and dominated the status fallback I/O cost.
compatibility: Preserves arbitrary checkpoint Value semantics and the original run_id.as_str filtering.
Preserves same-ID disk metadata invalidation, terminal-job skipping, assignment/subagent filtering, and pending-wait filtering.
Regression covers large checkpoint data and null, array, and string checkpoints without a bot.list failure.

real_job_directory_benchmark.method: Read-only temporary gateway test harness; harness removed after measurement.
real_job_directory_benchmark.buffered_full_job_improvement: 97.3% lower wall time than the old unbuffered reader path

pre_fix_sampling.observed_hot_path: status enrichment -> durable job count fallback -> serde_json job deserialization
pre_fix_sampling.interpretation: The sample identified durable-job status enrichment and its disk parsing path as a confirmed hotspot; no task, message, memory, or credential content was copied into this record.

validation.strict_clippy: existing gateway needless_question_mark/type_complexity warnings remain outside this change; no new warning from this change

runtime_followup.required: After the server-only update, repeat the read-only status/health latency and CPU observation against the updated service.
runtime_followup.not_claimed_here: This source benchmark is not a post-deployment production claim.
